measured_selection_pipeline.scope: Fresh full workflow: five independently launched adaptation processes, one fresh readout process, fixed candidate choice, and a final reference-Oracle adaptation if not already trained. Includes process/model startup, serialization and exact-weight/readout verification. Common target warmup and once-only predictor preparation excluded and charged separately. Representative start302 only; three timing repeats are not three scientific seed replications. Code uses existing subprocess boundaries rather than an optimized persistent model server.
measured_selection_pipeline.qualification: All freshly trained weights must be bitwise identical to frozen references. Readout logits/correctness and selected candidate must match frozen dev decisions exactly. No recipe or choice changes from timing outcomes. Separate exact-teacher-only scorer avoids charging learned-behavior features or initial anchors to the teacher control.
measured_selection_pipeline.important: One scientific warmup/update-seed pair and one candidate family, with repeated fresh workflow timing. This does not estimate across-start timing or generalize workflow cost to genre subsets. Once-only predictor preparation and the common target warmup are additional. Predictions and selected candidates reproduce the pre-existing frozen choices; no recipe is selected from these timings.
